description: Identifies HTTP methods commonly used to modify or delete application resources.
false_positives: Legitimate users modifying their own information.
Normal application workflows using PUT or PATCH requests.
Automated application testing and QA activities.
Authorized DELETE requests performed during routine maintenance.
tuning_adjustments: Review the source IP and user identity before escalating an alert.
Check whether the HTTP request was made by an authorized user.
Review the endpoint and timestamp to identify unusual modification activity.
Correlate modification requests with application audit logs.
Investigate repeated DELETE requests and unexpected modification activity.
investigation_guidance: Identify the user and source IP associated with the request.
Review the affected endpoint and HTTP method.
Check application audit logs for evidence of unauthorized changes.
Confirm whether the modification was authorized.
note: A matching request is an indicator for investigation, not proof of unauthorized modification.
